# Fashion Video Skill for Claude Code (full content)

A Claude Code skill that turns a fashion brief into a finished 6 to 15 second brand film: picture, motion, music and sound effects, all made in code. 22 styles, landscape and vertical. Built and tested with Claude Opus 5.5.

Website: https://opus55-video.solosoft.dev/
Buy: https://solopreneurhub.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/5fbdea48-cfb0-4d93-8926-11023d5ee7a0
Version: 2.0.2
Recommended model: Claude Opus 5.5

## What it does
Fashion Video Skill turns a brief (brand, collection, product photos, platform) into a finished video.mp4 whose picture, motion, music and sound effects are all generated by code. It plans the film from the brief's actual content: each beat gets enough time to be read, and the hero moment lands on the music's downbeat.

## How it works
1. Describe the brief: brand, product, any copy or photos, and where it will run.
2. Pick a style: choose one of the 22, or let Claude score them against the brief and pick.
3. Plan from your content: a content plan becomes a timed cue sheet.
4. Render picture and sound: frames are drawn in headless Chrome; the soundtrack and effects are composed to match the cuts.
5. Check before delivery: duration, size, loudness and true peak are measured; clipped text, overlaps and dead frames are flagged.

## What is included
- 22 styles: 7 fashion styles and 15 motion design styles, each with its own type, motion, transition and sound rules.
- Renderer: draws each frame in headless Chrome and encodes H.264 video with AAC audio, with optional motion blur.
- Sound engine: writes music in the style's genre, places one effect per beat, and masters to -14 LUFS.
- Imagery: your product photos, an image generator you already have (OpenAI, Gemini, local FLUX and others), or drawn entirely in code.
- Fonts: 36 font families under open licences, Latin and CJK.
- Quality checks: a spec check and a review gate.
- 22 worked examples: one reference film per style.

## Requirements
Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 selected, Node.js 18+, Python 3.10+ with numpy and scipy, ffmpeg, and Google Chrome or Chromium.

## FAQ
### Which Claude model should I use?
Claude Opus 5.5. We built and tested the skill with it, and every example film on this page was made with it: planning the beats, writing each frame, fixing layout problems and judging the review. Other models can run the skill, but we have not tested them to the same standard.

### What do I need to run it?
Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 selected, Node.js 18 or newer, Python 3.10 or newer with numpy and scipy, ffmpeg, and Google Chrome or Chromium. A setup check tells you exactly what is missing and how to fix it.

### Do I need an image generator?
No. Many styles are drawn entirely in code. Photo-led styles look best with your own product shots or images from a generator you have access to; without either, they fall back to drawn imagery.

### Can I use it for my own brand?
Yes. Give it your brand name, copy and photos you hold the rights to. Every brand in the example films is invented; the skill refuses to imitate real fashion houses or their logos.

### How long does a film take?
A 10 second 1080p film renders in about a minute on a recent laptop. Planning, review and revisions with Claude take longer, depending on how much you want to change.

### Who owns the films I make?
The films you make with the skill are yours to use. If you use AI-generated images inside them, the terms of that image provider also apply.

### Can I edit a film after it renders?
Yes. Each film is a folder with a content plan, a page and an audio script. Ask Claude to change copy, timing, colours or a single scene and render again.

## Notes
All brands in the example films are invented. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic; Claude and Claude Opus are trademarks of Anthropic.
